buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any

responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 4. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 5. Generic Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 7. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 8. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 9. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 10. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 11. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 11. . The Bidder should be an established supplier / assembler of High-End Workstations / Desktop Com

puters. 2. All accessories such as Keyboard, Mouse, Monitor, Cabinet, and internal components must be of re puted brands and supplied as a complete set. The brand name and model of each component must be clearly mentioned in the bid. 3. The Chassis, Monitor, Keyboard, and Mouse supplied must be compatible with the proposed Works tation configuration and must be supplied as a complete working set. 4. Past performance experience in the Government Sector must be provided along with satisfactory p erformance letters / work orders. 5. The Bidder must have functional service support in the district. Valid proof and contact details of th e service centre / service person must be uploaded at the time of bid submission. 6. The Operating System supplied must be Linux OS with native NVIDIA Driver Support. The Bidder m ust ensure all drivers including GPU, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and Chipset are fully compatible with Linux. Wi ndows only system will NOT be accepted. The OS installation details must be provided at the time o f supply. 7. The Bid-Specific Authorization / Dealer Authorization from the respective component manufacturer s / authorized distributors must be submitted at the time of participation, if available. The details inc luding Name, Designation, Address, E-mail ID, and Phone Number must be provided with the bid. 8. A declaration letter from the Bidder confirming that the Workstation is supplied with Linux OS with native NVIDIA support and all components are genuine must be uploaded at the time of participatio n. 9. Datasheets and relevant certifications for all hardware components must be submitted at the time of bidding. 10. The Bidder should have at least 3 years of experience in Workstation / Desktop PC supply / assembl ing. The corresponding certificate / proof must be submitted at the time of bidding. 11. RoHS Compliance and BEE / Energy Star Certificate for the quoted model / Monitor must be submitt ed, wherever applicable. 12. The proposed Workstation must be Linux compatible and certified. The hardware must be 64-bit. T he Hardware Compatibility details must be submitted. The same will be cross-checked at the site. 13. The vendor must rectify any reported hardware or software issue within 3 days. 14. Right to Cancel/Amend: The Purchaser reserves the right to cancel the bid or amend the terms and conditions at any time without prior information. 15. Downtime Penalty: A penalty of Rs. 500 per day will be imposed after 72 hours of downtime for eve ry additional day. 16. The manufacturing date of the hardware should not be more than three months prior to the date of supply. 17. The Workstation must be supplied with Intel Core Ultra 9 285K Processor or equivalent, Z890 Chips et Motherboard with Wi-Fi 6 & Bluetooth 5.3, 96GB GDDR7 ECC Professional GPU with Blackwell Arc hitecture or equivalent, 64GB (32GB x 2) DDR5 5600MHz RAM, 1200W 80+ Gold Modular SMPS, 360 mm AIO Liquid Cooler, 1TB NVMe Gen5 SSD with DRAM Cache, 24-inch 1080p 100Hz Monitor, Mid-T ower Cabinet with Additional 120mm PWM Rear Exhaust Fan, Keyboard, Mouse, Linux OS with nativ e NVIDIA support, and 3-year onsite warranty. Consumer / Gaming GPU will NOT be accepted. All co mponents must be genuine with bill and warranty card. 18. This bid is for a complete assembled Workstation set only. Bidders who are willing to supply the co mplete assembled set as per the required specification should only participate in this bid. Compone nt-wise / part-wise / incomplete bids will not be accepted. Evaluation will be done on Total Value Wi se basis. 19. The serial number of every supplied product shall be verified through the official manufacturer port al / invoice to confirm the genuineness of the product, quoted specifications, manufacturing details and warranty status. The bidder shall provide all necessary details required for such verification.

20. The bidder shall provide the official manufacturer website / portal link through which the purchaser can independently verify the genuineness, serial number, configuration and warranty status of the s upplied product. 21. Local Service Support: Local service support must be available for installation, commissioning, and configuration. The following local service details must be provided: (i) Office Address at Consignee Location (ii) Service Person's Name and Mobile Number. 22. During the validity period, the quoted products shall remain available for supply, and the Bidder sh all supply the offered products at the quoted prices and terms upon placement of the Purchase Orde r / GeM Order. (Undertaking to be uploaded in Letter Head) 23. In case of any queries or clarifications regarding the tender, bidders shall raise their queries only th rough the GeM Portal within the prescribed time limit specified by GeM, and queries submitted thro ugh any other mode or communication channel shall not be entertained or considered. 24. The Bidder should have a service centre in Tamil Nadu and near by consignee location for timely se rvice. The service centre address with telephone number should be provided in the bid document. N on-providing of the Service Centre in Tamil Nadu will lead to rejection. .
